usage: agentware plan set-state [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                [--actor {operator,loop}] [--reason REASON]
                                [--superseded-by SUPERSEDED_BY]
                                [--handle HANDLE] [--host HOST] [--now NOW]
                                feature
                                {draft,ready,running,done,superseded,cancelled}

positional arguments:
  feature               feature slug; dir under work/
  {draft,ready,running,done,superseded,cancelled}
                        target state

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --actor {operator,loop}
                        who is requesting the transition (worker-restricted
                        edges refuse actor=loop)
  --reason REASON       required for demotions / cancellations / the
                        cancelled->draft reopen
  --superseded-by SUPERSEDED_BY
                        required for any X -> superseded (the replacing
                        feature slug)
  --handle HANDLE       claim handle (default: resolved user handle)
  --host HOST           claim host (default: short hostname)
  --now NOW             ISO timestamp override (determinism/testing)
